title: A guard refuses a lane session started on a model other than the lane-session row's
why: Coordinator 23:55 CST Nov 8: it started tonight's lane sessions on claude-sonnet-5-5, but decision agent-model-cap's lane-session row says Opus (owner, 2026-10-28, item 50 b). No guard checked the model on create_session.
note: Fix: refuse a create_session tagged cs-build:lane whose model is not that row's model. Note owner item 439 direction (12:21 CST Nov 8, lanes run Sonnet for now, step lanes-sonnet-trial): the row and that direction must agree before the guard lands.
